Package com.stockroom.ui

Class InventoryGUI

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
com.stockroom.ui.InventoryGUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants
public class InventoryGUI extends JFrame
Main window of Stockroom, laid out as a stockroom ledger.

The window has four regions:

  • a manifest header with the "STOCKROOM" wordmark, the manifest line with today's date, and live TOTAL / LOW / OUT counters;
  • on the left (about 68%), a toolbar with the search field, the status filter and VIEW ALL, above the ledger table. A CardLayout swaps the table for an EmptyStatePanel when there is nothing to list;
  • on the right (about 32%), the Entry Slip with the item form, its buttons and the Update-by-ID mini-form;
  • a status bar with keyboard hints and the save status.

The window observes the InventoryManager, so the table, counters and empty state refresh by themselves after every change.

      Builds the main window for an inventory. The window is not shown until Window.setVisible(boolean) is called.
      Parameters:
      manager - the inventory to show and edit

  • Method Details

    • buildHeader

      private JPanel buildHeader()
      Builds the manifest header: wordmark and manifest line on the left, live counters on the right, and a 2px ink rule underneath.
      Returns:
      the header panel

    • createWindowIcons

      private static List<Image> createWindowIcons()
      Paints the window icon at several sizes, replacing Java's default coffee cup: an ink square holding a paper "S" in Space Grotesk, with an orange accent bar along the bottom, like a ledger stamp.
      Returns:
      the icon images, smallest first

    • createCounterNumeral

      private static JLabel createCounterNumeral()
      Creates the large mono numeral used by a header counter.
      Returns:
      the numeral label, showing "0"

    • buildCounter

      private static JPanel buildCounter(String caption, JLabel numeral, boolean ruleLeft)
      Builds one header counter: a caption above a large numeral, with a thin vertical rule on its left when it is not the first counter.
      Parameters:
      caption - small caption, such as "LOW"
      numeral - the numeral label, updated by refreshCounters()
      ruleLeft - true to draw a vertical rule on the left
      Returns:
      the counter panel

    • buildBody

      private JPanel buildBody()
      Builds the body: the ledger column on the left and the Entry Slip on the right, splitting extra width about 68 / 32.
      Returns:
      the body panel

    • buildLedgerColumn

      private JPanel buildLedgerColumn()
      Builds the ledger column: the toolbar above the card panel that holds the table and the empty state.
      Returns:
      the ledger column panel

    • configureTable

      private void configureTable()
      Configures the ledger table: row height, ruled lines, renderers, column widths and sorting.

    • configureColumn

      private static void configureColumn(TableColumn column, TableCellRenderer renderer, boolean rightAligned, int width, boolean flexible)
      Sets one column's renderers and width.
      Parameters:
      column - the table column
      renderer - the cell renderer
      rightAligned - true to right-align the header, for numeric columns
      width - preferred width, in pixels
      flexible - true if the column should soak up spare width

    • buildEntrySlip

      private JPanel buildEntrySlip()
      Builds the Entry Slip: title and mode tag, the three item fields, the slip buttons, a dashed divider and the Update-by-ID mini-form. The content sits in a borderless scroll pane, so it scrolls instead of being squashed when the window is short.
      Returns:
      the Entry Slip panel

    • addRow

      private static void addRow(JPanel panel, Component row, GridBagConstraints c, int gapBelow)
      Adds one full-width row to a grid-bag column, followed by a gap.
      Parameters:
      panel - the panel using a GridBagLayout
      row - the component to add
      c - shared constraints; only the bottom inset is changed
      gapBelow - space below the row, in pixels

      private JPanel buildStatusBar()
      Builds the status bar: keyboard hints on the left, save status on the right, with a thin rule above.

      the status bar panel

      Gives a status-bar label its small, muted mono style.

      label - the label to style

    • setNewEntryMode

      private void setNewEntryMode()
      Puts the Entry Slip in "new entry" mode: NEW ENTRY tag, ADD TO LEDGER button, and VOID ENTRY disabled because there is nothing to delete.

    • setEditMode

      private void setEditMode(Item item)
      Puts the Entry Slip in edit mode for an item: fills in its name, quantity and threshold, shows an orange "EDITING #0007" tag, renames the primary button to SAVE CHANGES and enables VOID ENTRY.
      Parameters:
      item - the item to edit

    • resetSlip

      private void resetSlip()
      Empties the slip, removes every error, deselects the table and returns to new-entry mode.

      Empties the name, quantity and threshold fields.

    • refresh

      private void refresh()
      Reloads the table from the inventory, re-applies the search and filter, then updates the counters and chooses between the table and the empty state.

    • refreshCounters

      Updates the TOTAL, LOW and OUT counters. LOW and OUT turn their status colour when above zero.

    • refreshCard

      private void refreshCard()
      Shows the empty state when the inventory is empty or nothing matches the current search and filter; shows the table otherwise.

    • applyFilters

      private void applyFilters()
      Applies the search text and the status filter to the table. Name matching is done by InventoryManager.searchByName(String), so the search rule lives in the service layer.

    • selectedStatus

      Returns the status chosen in the ALL / IN / LOW / OUT filter.
      Returns:
      the chosen status, or null for ALL

    • wireActions

      private void wireActions()
      Connects every button, field, the table selection and the keyboard shortcuts to their handler methods.

    • loadInventory

      public void loadInventory()
      Loads the saved inventory into the window and shows the result in the status bar. If the data file cannot be read, an error toast explains that changes will not be saved this session, so the file is left untouched. Call after the window is shown.

    • refreshSaveStatus

      private void refreshSaveStatus()
      Updates the save status in the status bar from the manager: SAVED with the time of the last save, or SAVE FAILED in red. Leaves the text alone when no save has happened yet.

      private void onPrimary(ActionEvent e)
      Handles the primary slip button and Enter in the slip fields: adds a new entry in new-entry mode, or saves changes in edit mode.

    • addEntry

      private void addEntry()
      Adds the slip's contents as a new item. On success the slip is emptied, the new row flashes orange and a receipt toast appears; on failure the error is shown under the right field.

    • saveEntry

      private void saveEntry()
      Saves the slip's contents over the item being edited. On success the slip returns to new-entry mode and a receipt toast appears. If the item has disappeared, the stale entry is handled gracefully.
